# Pull request

## Problem and resulting change

Describe the concrete problem and what a learner or contributor can do after this change.

## Release information

Use a Conventional Commit title. Describe any learner/contributor outcome and migration or compatibility actions here; write "None" for internal-only changes. Keep important details in the final squash commit body. Ordinary PRs do not edit CHANGELOG.md or add changeset files while release automation is deferred.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Include relevant mathematical, bilingual, accessibility, or privacy review.

## Remaining decisions or limitations

State assumptions, unverified claims, and deferred scope.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and the project status is accurate.
- [ ] The current `docs` check passes and the branch is up to date before merging.
- [ ] Release information is captured above; ordinary changes leave CHANGELOG.md untouched.
- [ ] Relevant French/English content and source references are consistent.
- [ ] No credentials, learner data, or unlicensed third-party material are included.
